mapper.select:
SELECT ci.id AS cart_id, ci.quantity,
p.id, p.category_id, p.name, p.short_description, p.description, p.sku, p.barcode, p.brand, p.price, p.subscription_price, p.stock_quantity, p.weight_gram, p.is_active, p.is_featured, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked
FROM cart_items ci
INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = ci.product_id
LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.product_id = p.id AND f.user_id = ci.user_id
WHERE ci.user_id = #{user_id} AND p.is_active = 1
ORDER BY ci.id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items ( user_id, product_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{user_id}, #{product_id}, IFNULL(#{quantity}, 1), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + IFNULL(VALUES(quantity), 1), updated_at = NOW()
